```{r}
library(dplyr)

library(lubridate)

library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
br_all_grazers = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XqsI25WqmtFHuYAPvPWEGXigq8hOMziOpn_0ccZi1ec/edit?gid=0#gid=0')
head(br_all_grazers)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Columns to include
br_all_grazer_cols <- c(
  "total_purple_urchin",
  "purple_urchins_<2cm",
  "purple_urchins_>2cm",
  "red_urchins",
  "tegula"
)

# Convert list-columns to numeric
to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (!is.list(x)) return(as.numeric(x))

  map_dbl(x, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    as.numeric(.x[[1]])
  })
}

br_all_grazer_long <- br_all_grazers %>%
  mutate(
    survey_date = as.Date(
      sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", year, month, date)
    ),
    sample_month = as.Date(
      format(survey_date, "%Y-%m-01")
    ),
    across(all_of(br_all_grazer_cols), to_numeric)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(br_all_grazer_cols),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "density"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = recode(
      species,
      "total_purple_urchin" = "Total purple urchins",
      "purple_urchins_<2cm" = "Purple urchins <2 cm",
      "purple_urchins_>2cm" = "Purple urchins >2 cm",
      "red_urchins" = "Red urchins",
      "tegula" = "Tegula"
    )
  )
```

#mean and SE
```{r}
# Calculate density for each observation (individuals/m²)
br_all_grazer_monthly <- br_all_grazer_long %>%
  mutate(
    density = density / 3.14
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    sample_month,
    treatment,
    plot_id,
    species
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    density = if (all(is.na(density))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(density, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(density))

# Calculate monthly mean density and SE
br_all_grazer_monthly_summary <- br_all_grazer_monthly %>%
  group_by(
    sample_month,
    treatment,
    species
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(density),
    se = sd(density) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
br_all_purple <- br_all_grazer_monthly_summary %>%
  filter(
    species %in% c(
      "Total purple urchins",
      "Purple urchins <2 cm",
      "Purple urchins >2 cm"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = sample_month,
      y = mean_density,
      color = species,
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, mean_density - se),
      ymax = mean_density + se
    ),
    width = 5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "2 months",
    date_labels = "%b %Y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Purple urchin density over time",
    x = "Date",
    y = expression("Density (individuals/m"^2*")"),
    color = "Size class"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

br_all_purple
```

```{r}
br_urchins_2526 <- br_all_grazer_monthly_summary %>%
  filter(
    sample_month >= as.Date("2025-01-01"),
    sample_month <= as.Date("2026-12-31"),
    species %in% c(
      "Purple urchins <2 cm",
      "Purple urchins >2 cm",
      "Red urchins"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = c(
        "Purple urchins <2 cm",
        "Purple urchins >2 cm",
        "Red urchins"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = sample_month,
      y = mean_density,
      color = species
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, mean_density - se),
      ymax = mean_density + se
    ),
    width = 6,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Purple urchins <2 cm" = "#9C65B8",
      "Purple urchins >2 cm" = "#542788",
      "Red urchins" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_labels = "%b %Y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Urchin density over time (2025–2026)",
    x = "Date",
    y = expression("Density (individuals/m"^2*")"),
    color = "Species / Size class"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

br_urchins_2526
```
